description: Source code for URL helper functions using libcurl, including HTTP requests, multipart uploads, file downloads, SSL verification, and mTLS configuration with PKI support.

classes.name: ResponseBuffer
classes.description: Structure for managing response data buffer during HTTP requests.

classes.name: fileDownloadData
classes.description: Structure for managing file download data including file pointer and size.

classes.name: MimeFileInfo
classes.description: Structure representing multipart file part information.

classes.name: MimePartInfo
classes.description: Structure representing multipart form data part information.

methods.name: performRequest
methods.description: Executes the cURL request, retries without mTLS if client cert is invalid.

methods.name: urlHelperCreateCurl
methods.description: Creates and initializes a cURL handle.

methods.name: urlHelperDestroyCurl
methods.description: Cleans up and frees a cURL handle.

methods.name: writefunc
methods.description: Callback for writing received data into ResponseBuffer.

methods.name: urlHelperPerformRequestInternal
methods.description: Performs HTTP request with options, handles headers, POST data, and response.

methods.name: onCurlXferInfo
methods.description: Progress callback to handle request cancellation.

methods.name: urlHelperDownloadFile
methods.description: Downloads a file from URL to specified path.

methods.name: urlHelperCanVerifyHost
methods.description: Checks if URL hostname can be verified (not IP address).

methods.name: setmTLSOptions
methods.description: Configures mTLS options for cURL context using PKI service.

methods.name: curlDebugCallback
methods.description: Debug callback for cURL verbose output.

methods.name: destroyMimeFileInfo
methods.description: Frees MimeFileInfo structure and its members.

methods.name: destroyMimePartInfo
methods.description: Frees MimePartInfo structure and its members.
